title: Quantum advantages for syndrome-aware noisy logical observable estimation
summary: Recent progress in fault-tolerant quantum computing suggests that leveraging error-syndrome information at the logical layer can substantially improve performance, including the estimation of logical observables from noisy states. In this work, based on quantum estimation theory, we develop an information-theoretic framework to quantify the utility of error syndromes for noisy logical observable estimation.
